description: This bundle acts as an agent for the remote launching architecture. When started, it will bind to port 29998 and listens for incoming requests. When this port is accessed, it will open a link that allows it to act as an OSGi management agent that is remotely controlled. When this connection is closed, it will remove all bundles that were installed through this connection. The protocol is highly optimized to make this also work for small devices and slow connections.
